drivers.title: Mega creators and a new launch lifted Skintific's reach
drivers.why: Two mega creators posted Skintific's new launch to 1.7M and 971K views, and a nano account with 5K followers drew 2.9M across three posts. Views rose from 1.2M to 10.9M while panel TikTok views grew 11%.
drivers.attention_to_action: The reach came from posts without cart links, and cart share rose only to 31%. The selling ran through the sale tag: 28 creators on #dealsforyoudays.

actions.title: Pair a mega reveal with a nano wave
actions.detail: Skintific's reach came from two mega posts plus one nano breakout. Brief one or two big names for the reveal and let nano creators carry the volume.

actions.title: Join the platform sale tag with carts on
actions.detail: Skintific held 88% of #dealsforyoudays posts with 28 creators. For the next TikTok Shop campaign, brief creators to use the tag and the cart together.
